notes: Channel lists come from UEFA.com's 2026/27 Nations League 'Where to watch' page (dated 6 Oct 2026), which covers the league phase played Sept-Nov 2026. Nations League rights are sold by UEFA under its national-team (2024-28) cycle, separately from club competitions. UEFA does not mark free-to-air: freeToAir=true means the broadcaster is a public/free-to-air channel or an official free stream (TF1+, RaiPlay, RTVE Play, Yle Areena, BBC iPlayer, SRG Play, UEFA.tv); free broadcasters usually show their own national team, but UEFA does not state exact match allocations except in the UK and where UEFA.tv is restricted. UEFA.tv (UEFA's free streaming platform) covers several territories without a broadcaster. Where UEFA lists the same territory twice under different names (Eswatini/Swaziland, St Kitts and Nevis/St Christopher, BVI/Tortola, Bonaire/Saba/St Eustatius) they are merged into one entry. Russia is listed because UEFA's page lists a broadcaster (Okko) there.
